bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm Nespresso Machine
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found {name}. Leave this empty on a machine that has never been paired and the integration generates its own token. If the Nespresso app already paired this machine, paste the 32 character pairing key from your Nespresso account so both keep working, or the 16 character auth token from a Bluetooth capture.

user.title: Nespresso Smart
user.description: This integration requires Bluetooth. Machines are discovered automatically.

error.invalid_auth_token: That is neither a pairing key nor an auth token. Expected 32 hex characters from your Nespresso account, or 16 from a Bluetooth capture.

abort.bluetooth_only: This integration discovers machines via Bluetooth automatically. Ensure Bluetooth is enabled and the machine is powered on.

data.persistent_connection: Persistent connection (real-time updates, blocks Nespresso app)
data.send_tx_level: Send the TX level request when onboarding

scan_wifi.name: Scan for WiFi networks
scan_wifi.description: Ask the machine which WiFi networks it can see. The machine does the scanning, not Home Assistant, so the list is what the machine can reach.

config_entry_id.name: Machine
config_entry_id.description: The Nespresso machine to act on.

configure_wifi.name: Configure WiFi
configure_wifi.description: Put the machine on a WiFi network. The passphrase is sent to the machine in clear, exactly as the official Nespresso app sends it. Watch the WiFi status sensor for the result.

config_entry_id.name: Machine
config_entry_id.description: The Nespresso machine to act on.

market.name: Market
market.description: Two-letter country code, for example GB. The machine will not reach Nespresso's servers without it.

ssid.name: Network name
ssid.description: The SSID to join, at most 32 bytes.

password.name: Passphrase
password.description: At most 64 bytes. Leave empty for an open network.

connection_index.name: Connection index
connection_index.description: Echo the index from a scan result. Leave at 255 when typing the network in by hand.
